test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 28 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom:
'Fell foul of'

options.text: To get into a conflict or trouble with someone
To behave in a funny way

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **To get into a conflict or trouble with someone**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Fell foul of"** means to get into a conflict or trouble with someone or something. (किसी से झगड़ा या परेशानी में पड़ना) • **Example:** The company fell foul of regulators due to non-compliance with safety regulations. • It refers to situations where someone or something gets into trouble, often due to breaking rules, offending someone, or causing a conflict. (समस्या या विवाद में पड़ना) • **Example:** He fell foul of his boss after missing several deadlines. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To make an unexpected profit** (अनपेक्षित लाभ कमाना): Refers to gaining money or advantage unexpectedly. • **Example:** She made an unexpected profit by selling her old artwork. • **Option 2: To avoid a conflict successfully** (सफलतापूर्वक विवाद से बचना): Refers to managing a situation effectively without getting into trouble. • **Example:** He avoided a conflict successfully by apologizing before the situation escalated. • **Option 4: To behave in a funny way** (मजेदार तरीके से व्यवहार करना): Refers to acting in an amusing or comical manner. • **Example:** The clown behaved in a funny way to entertain the children. d3:Tff2, सही उत्तर है: **विकल्प 3** अर्थात **किसी के साथ झगड़े या परेशानी में पड़ना**।
